source.label: Official vendor pages and documentation reviewed on 27 September 2026
source.description: Desk research; product claims are vendor-reported, not implementation tests. Suitability is analyst inference. Unknown means not established, not absent.
filters: Egypt-local, regional, international, and agentic/specialist products
Kandil has more than 1,000 employees; exact headcount unknown
caveats: Non-exhaustive market scan; no demos, procurement quotes or customer-reference calls performed.
Origin labels describe verified market footprint where legal domicile is unverified.
Public page and indexed extracts can differ; confirm prices, versions and terms with vendors.
Confirmed by Ibrahim: Kandil HR uses Google Sheets; Odoo is comparison-only due to licensing cost.

evidenceFlow.title: Retrieve public evidence
evidenceFlow.detail: Use web.run open with each source URL; where direct retrieval fails use search_query restricted to that vendor and product. Retain the source URL and review date.

evidenceFlow.title: Compare
evidenceFlow.detail: Manually paraphrase advertised capabilities; separate country payroll evidence, prices and integration claims from analyst suitability judgements. No numerical vendor scores assigned.

metricDefinitions.label: Kandil fit
metricDefinitions.definition: Provisional analyst routing for demonstration priority, not a tested score or endorsement.

metricDefinitions.label: Egypt payroll
metricDefinitions.definition: Evidence in reviewed vendor materials; does not certify compliance or prove a tested implementation.

methods.code: One row per product offering. Group by market footprint. Keep unknown capabilities explicit. Prioritise Egyptian payroll evidence, operational workforce fit, enterprise proof and integration potential.
